headline: Malaysian Palm Oil to China Dropped 39% Before Trump Met Xi
context: Malaysia's palm oil exports to China fell 39% in Jan-Oct 2025, six months before Trump met Xi in Beijing. The plantation minister attributed the drop to price, not geopolitics. China's COFCO signed over US$10 billion of competing Brazilian oilseed deals in November 2025.

changes.summary: Correction: we now describe COFCO as Chinese, take the smallholder figures from a PNB Research Institute study (about 208,000 independent smallholders on 27% of planted area), paraphrase the US trade representative, attribute the US tariff point to the plantation minister and give the oleochemical rise as a one-month change; we removed a full-year export figure and claims about mill-gate pricing and corporate hedging that we could not confirm.

Correction: we no longer say the fall in exports to China lands its cost on smallholders, which no source shows. The issue now says smallholders live with palm oil's price swings, as a PNB Research Institute study found, and asks whether new buyers can steady that price.

cards.big: Malaysian palm oil to China fell 39% before Trump met Xi. About 208,000 smallholders live with the price swings
cards.sub: Plantation Minister Johari attributed the drop to price (CPO at one point USD120 a tonne above soybean oil), not geopolitics. A PNB study found volatile prices squeeze their livelihoods.

cards.big: Palm oil traded USD120 a tonne above soybean oil at one point in 2025, and Chinese refiners shifted mix
cards.sub: Malaysia's 2024 exports to China were 1.39 million tonnes, down 5.3% on 2023. The Jan-Oct 2025 drop hit 39%.

cards.big: China signed an oilseed deal with Brazil worth more than US$10 billion in November 2025
cards.sub: COFCO inked agreements reported at roughly 20 million tonnes of soybeans, soybean oil and palm oil with ADM, Bunge, Cargill and Louis Dreyfus. Signed contracts, not delivered cargo.

cards.big: Greer announced the deal. China's foreign ministry said working teams were still in consultation
cards.sub: Greer told Bloomberg he expects double-digit billions in farm purchases a year for three years. Wang Yi said specifics were under consultation. July soybean futures fell 36 cents a bushel that day.

cards.big: When CPO falls, smallholders absorb it
cards.sub: About 208,000 independent smallholders manage 27% of the planted area. Kenya overtook the EU as #2 buyer in H1 2025. Johari says palm oil faces no US tariffs. April oleochemical exports rose 23.83% on March.

cards.big: The question is not whether Trump shook palm oil. It is whether new buyers like Kenya can steady the price smallholders depend on.
The summit did not cause Malaysia's palm oil problem. Price did, in 2025, before Trump met Xi
cards.sub: Malaysia is rerouting to Kenya, palm oil pays no US tariff and April oleochemical exports rose 23.83% on March. The harder story is the gap between trade-policy timetables and smallholder-income timetables.
